text: sample s (unique combination site visit, species lifestage) fished n_s passes, let y_{si} number fish caught pass p_{si} capture probability pass. probability fish first caught pass \pi_{si} = p_{si} \prod_{j < } (1 - p_{sj}) Conditional total catch, T_s = \sum_i y_{si}, counts multinomial probabilities \pi_{si} / P_s, P_s = \sum_i \pi_{si} cumulative capture probability. gives log likelihood \ell = \sum_s \left( \sum_i y_{si} \log \pi_{si} - T_s \log P_s \right) depend unknown number fish site. Capture probability modelled logit scale \text{logit}(p_{si}) = \mathbf{x}_{si}^\top \boldsymbol{\beta} + \mathbf{z}_{si}^\top \mathbf{b}, \qquad b_k \sim N(0, \sigma_{g(k)}^2) \boldsymbol{\beta} fixed effects \mathbf{b} optional random effects, example visit sample, one standard deviation \sigma_g random effect term. random effects integrated likelihood using Laplace approximation, fixed effects standard deviations estimated maximum likelihood using RTMB. Fish density estimated dividing total catch area fished cumulative capture probability: T_s / (A_s P_s).

title: Estimate abundance and density from removal samples — abundance
text: Two targets available, estimate different standard errors: "realised" number fish \(N\) present sample taken. Given \(N\), catch binomial, \(T \sim     \textrm{Bin}(N, P)\), (Huggins, 1989) $$\textrm{var}(\hat N) \approx \hat N (1 - P) / P +       \hat N^2 (1 - P)^2 \textrm{var}(\textrm{logit}(P)).$$ lower confidence limit less catch. "expected" expected number fish \(\lambda\), example density times area, number present \(N \sim \textrm{Poisson}(\lambda)\). catch \(T \sim \textrm{Poisson}(\lambda P)\), first term variance \(\hat\lambda / P\), also includes natural variation \(N\) \(\lambda\). standard error larger factor \(1 / \sqrt{1 - P}\) \(P\) well estimated. Use "realised" say many fish present, "expected" describe underlying abundance, example comparing sites years. Poisson model counts offset \(\log(P)\), \(\) area, model expected abundance. Confidence intervals computed log scale. total catch zero estimated abundance zero confidence limits NA. , abundance summed samples group, example lifestages caught site year. variation catches independent samples, estimates \(P\) correlated, depend model coefficients, allowed : $$\textrm{var}(\sum_s \hat N_s) \approx \sum_s v_s + w^\top \Sigma w,$$ \(v_s\) \(\hat N_s (1 - P_s) / P_s\) realised abundance \(\hat N_s / P_s\) expected abundance, \(w_s = \hat N_s (1 - P_s)\) \(\Sigma\) covariance matrix \(\textrm{logit}(P_s)\).
